messages.content:
You are walking along a straight corridor 1.75 m wide. Another person, Person 2, is walking towards you, facing you, 6 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are. The corridor has two long sides, the window side and the shop side. You are 0.9 m from the window side. Person 2 says: "I'll keep to the window side." Which side do you move towards, the window side or the shop side?

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Shop side
Person 2 has declared they will move to the window side, so you should move to the opposite (shop) side to pass safely.
